description: Issue #35 part 4V, lesson 04-22 (docs/part04v/04-22-characters-indicators-subroutines.md). Uploads three fixed-form RPG IV ports of RPG III programs (V0422A=R0403A, V0422B=R0404A, V0422C=R0405A; src/qrpglesrc/v0422*s.rpgle), the exercise answers V0422D-G (solutions/04-22) and the CASxx/CABxx reading sample V0422P into QRPGLESRC (RCDLEN 112, created if absent), sets SRCTYPE(RPGLE), compiles all with CRTBNDRPG OPTION(*EVENTF) and copies the compile event file into VFYEVF (member name = source member). Four NEGATIVE members record the real compile errors of RPG III habits: V0422W (EXCPT spelling), V0422X (COMP result indicators in the RPG III place, cols 54-59), V0422Y (CLEAR target in Factor 2), V0422Z (the RPG III source src/qrpgsrc/r0404s.rpg pasted unchanged). Every compile is monitored, so a failure does not stop the wrapper. Then CALLs V0422A-G and V0422P (QSYSPRT only, no input files, no interactive I/O, no loop). Results of the first run (2026-10-04): compile listings and program printouts appear in the raw run section without any CPYSPLF capture (those steps were removed); the compile event file is found as &LIB/EVFEVENT, not QTEMP/EVFEVENT. Expected V2 values recorded for the RPG III originals (04-03/04-04/04-05): V0422A 'A=JOHNSON     B=ALHNSON     C=123456  D=1234AB  E=BOB'; V0422B 'REORDER' at cols 31-40; V0422C 'A             SUM= 00015'. Hand-computed values for V0422D-G and V0422P were all confirmed by the first run (2026-10-04); control-spec H DFTACTGRP(*YES), MOVEL(P)/MOVE(P) and packed D-spec fields printing as 00015 also worked. No RMVLIBLE step on purpose: the harness has no placeholder for the user's first library, and every object here is library-qualified (&LIB/...), so a same-named object in that library cannot be picked up. sshTimeoutMs is raised to 600000 because one connection holds 12 compiles and 8 calls.

steps.label: INQDFT
steps.cmd: CHGJOB INQMSGRPY(*DFT)

steps.label: CRTEVF
steps.cmd:
CHKOBJ OBJ(&LIB/VFYEVF) OBJTYPE(*FILE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF9801) EXEC(CRTPF FILE(&LIB/VFYEVF) RCDLEN(300) TEXT('compile event capture'))

steps.label: CLREVF
steps.cmd: CLRPFM FILE(&LIB/VFYEVF)

steps.label: TYA
steps.cmd: CHGPFM FILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) MBR(V0422A) SRCTYPE(RPGLE)

steps.label: CPA
steps.cmd: CRTBNDRPG PGM(&LIB/V0422A) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(V0422A) OPTION(*EVENTF) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: EWA
steps.cmd: CPYF FROMFILE(&LIB/EVFEVENT) FROMMBR(V0422A) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYEVF) MBROPT(*ADD) FMTOPT(*NOCHK)
